whisper · shared by all ten languages

No buttons: the language of each utterance is recognised and translated into the other one as soon as the speaker pauses. Both people simply talk in turn. While a translation is being read aloud the microphone is closed for a moment; long stretches of speech are translated in pieces at the speaker\'s pauses.
Speech is processed on this device only and is never sent anywhere.

Runs whisper\'s encoder on the graphics chip through Vulkan. Faster on some phones, slower or unstable on others, and the first start after switching takes a few seconds to compile shaders. If the app crashes with it on, it switches itself back off.
The app did not start properly with GPU speech recognition on, so it has been switched off again.
Uses the dedicated model for a language pair when one exists, and the LLM otherwise. Fastest.
Dedicated translation models only. Directions without one, such as anything into Thai, will not translate.
Translates every direction with a single LLM. Slower, but it detects the spoken language itself. Needs 1.1 GB.

Used for directions without a dedicated model, such as into Thai. The larger model translates noticeably better and about twice as slowly; it is the default on phones with 8 GB of memory or more and needs at least 6 GB. A model that is not installed is downloaded when the chosen languages need one.

Whisper small (190 MB) recognises Korean, English, Spanish, Japanese and Chinese well and is the fastest. Whisper medium hears Thai, Vietnamese and Indonesian noticeably better and takes about three times as long per sentence; it is the default on phones with 8 GB of memory or more. A model that is not installed is downloaded when you choose it.

Both speech models, every translation model and both LLMs in one go. Afterwards no language or model choice needs a download. Wi-Fi recommended; an interrupted download resumes.
